skeleton:
Homemade British-Style Baked Beans

British · Easy · Makes about 600 g (serves 6)

Jump to Recipe Method Troubleshooting Storage
The honest upgrade to the Heinz can: navy beans simmered in a tomato-molasses sauce that runs closer to the British standard than the American Boston baked bean — sweeter, saucier, and less smoky — and seasoned with the quiet depth that the café's beans carry. This master is the from-scratch version the full English master already named as its beans component, written at the bean pot's own scale.

Quantities live in the recipe card.

The beans

- The overnight soak is the bean canon's law — navy beans from dry take the full simmer; canned beans (the honest shortcut) cut the cooking to 30 minutes and the depth by half.

Homemade British-Style Baked Beans

Prep: 10 minutes · Cook: 45 minutes · Total: About 55 minutes · Makes about 600 g (serves 6)

Ingredients

The beans

  • 400 g dried navy beans (or cannellini), soaked overnight
  • 1 L water
  • 1 onion (100 g), finely diced
  • 30 g tomato paste
  • 400 g canned crushed tomatoes
  • 60 g molasses or treacle
  • 40 g brown sugar
  • 15 ml / 15 g cider vinegar
  • 5 g English mustard powder
  • 5 g fine sea salt; 2 g black pepper
  • 1 bay leaf

Instructions

  1. The long simmer. The drained beans, water, onion, bay, and a pinch of salt in a pot at the murmur — 45 minutes to 1 hour until the beans are fully tender. core — the olla master's law, inherited without amendment. Checkpoint — a bean crushes creamy with no chalky
  2. The sauce's build. The tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, molasses, sugar, vinegar, mustard, salt, and pepper stirred into the tender beans; the pot returned to the murmur, uncovered, 20–30 minutes until the sauce has thickened to a glossy, spoon-coating consistency. the beans hold as one dark, glossy mass — the British bean runs saucier and sweeter than the American, and the molasses' depth is the flavor's backbone. Checkpoint — the sauce coats a spoon heavily and
  3. Serve hot with the full English, on toast, or as the component the café table expects. with the molasses' depth and the mustard's bite — the breakfast bean, made honest. Checkpoint — the first spoonful runs sweet-savory

Storage, Make-Ahead & Variations

- 5 days refrigerated; freezes 3 months — the batch-cook version the working week runs on. - With a spoon of the brown breakfast sauce master's version stirred in at the finish, the depth doubles — a documented upgrade.

methodSteps.chefsNote: the British-vs-Boston distinction: the American baked bean runs pork-fat and brown-sugar forward with a smoky depth; the British version runs tomato-sauce forward with a molasses sweetness and a mustard-sharp background that the Heinz can carries as its signature. This recipe leans British: more tomato, less smoke, and the treacle's dark caramel carrying what the American version gets from bacon.
